name: Mailrith
description: Review Subscribers and email results, prepare and deliver Broadcasts, and manage Sequences, Automations, targeting, and email Templates.

use_cases.title: Review Email Performance
use_cases.prompt: Show my recent Broadcast results and summarize what changed.

use_cases.title: Prepare A Broadcast
use_cases.prompt: Create a draft Broadcast from my welcome Template and run preflight.

use_cases.title: Manage A Subscriber
use_cases.prompt: Find ada@example.com and add the Customer Tag.

data_handling.connection_scope: One Mailrith workspace selected during OAuth
data_handling.credentials: OAuth tokens are never returned by Mailrith tools
data_handling.subscriber_data: Tools return only the requested bounded page or selected Subscriber
data_handling.retention: The connector adds no Mailrith database storage beyond normal product records and OAuth authorization records
